Lucknow's 80-Year Old Top Breakfast Spot Durga Khasta's Story | Khasta Kachori with Aloo & Matar
videos.description:
It’s 4 AM and you have an uncontrolled craving for Khasta- where do you go?
Durga Khasta it is. 

Started as a small stall by Durga Prasad Sahu Ji about 80 years ago this place tops the breakfast charts of Lucknow. 

Ajay Kumar Sahu in 1985 took over the stall- at that time it used to be known as Ajay khasta. In 2002, they opened a proper shop by the name ‘Durga Khasta’.

Based close to the Charbagh Railway station they have a lot of tourists coming in on a daily basis.

Find out the full story about this place in this video. 

📍Durga Khasta
Latouche Road Tiraha, Ghasyari Mandi, Naka Hindola, Lucknow.
⏰4 AM- 3 PM

Lucknow’s 136 Year-Old Legendary Raheem’s Nahari & Gilafi Kulcha Since 1890 | Purana Lucknow Non-Veg
videos.description:
In this video we explored the Legendary Nahari from Raheem’s Hotel, Lucknow which started way back in 1890. 

They started the culture of Nahari Kulcha in Lucknow.

In fact the Gilafi Kulcha served with Nahari was invented by the founder of Raheem Hotel Haji Abdul Raheem Sahab.

The Nahari is cooked overnight and prepared to perfection such that the shop sees a lot of crowd- both local and tourists from the time shop opens in the morning.

Whereas the Gilafi Kulcha- Named by Bilaal Ahmed’s Grandfather Haji Abdul Raheem is a layered kulcha which perfectly compliments the Nahari in all aspects.

We also discussed how this Nahari is different from the one served in Delhi as it is lesser spicy as compared to Delhi where it is eaten with Khamiri Roti as opposed to Gilafi Kulcha in Lucknow.

Explore more about this Kulcha Nahari in this video and comment your feedback of this place and which place should we cover for our next video.

📍Raheem’s Hotel(Since 1890)
Opp. Tunday Kababi, 28-26, Phool Wali Gali, Chowk, Lucknow.

Sahabdeen- Lucknow's Original Bakse Wale Khaste in Chowk since 1938 | Hard, Soft & Medium Khaste
videos.description:
Hidden gems like Sahabdeen are the reason that Lucknow has been recognised as UNESCO's City for Gastronomy. These spots are so underrated that you would need to explore the lanes of old city to find the real taste. These places are such that only a true Lucknowite can find them.

Started by his grandfather Sahabdeen, Guddu Bhaiya now sells these Khaste in the narrow lanes of Chowk. This was started before Independence in 1938 which means its been now 88 years of these Khaste being in business. You might find many Khasta sellers at Gol Darwaza but these are the original ones and really the taste they serve is unmatched. The popularity in Chowk is such that Sahabdeen's Khaste are already sold out before Guddu Bhaiya can make it to Gol Darwaza 15 days a month.

They serve 3 varieties of Khaste namely- Hard, Medium and Soft based upon the amount of crunch they have. These are served with spicy/chatpate masala aloo which is a perfect pairing.

To know more check out the full video and in case you like the video, give us a subscribe :)
